lines.zh: 我走过的地方石头裂开
lines.en: The stone cracks where I walk

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，地面却塌
lines.en: My steps are light, yet the ground caves
I touch a wall and it crumbles
Fine cracks cover me

lines.zh: 我慢慢地朝有东西的地方走
lines.en: I walk slowly toward whatever's there
I raise a hand and powder falls
I avoid the load-bearing beam

lines.zh: 我走的路线都是最脆的
lines.en: I take the most brittle line

lines.zh: 我经过一棵树，树心空了
lines.en: I pass a tree and its heart is hollow
Every stretch I pause

lines.zh: 我踩过石砖，砖陷了下去
lines.en: I cross the flagstones and they sink
No hurry; brittle things wait
I stand, shedding flakes

lines.zh: 我脚下的地出现了网纹
lines.en: A web of cracks forms under me
My edges wear away in the wind
I'm not moving, yet I'm lessening
I raise a hand and watch it flake
The walls here are all unsound
I hear something inside the stone
I blink slowly, without eyes
The air is full of fine dust
I wait for the thinnest side
There are seams in your armor
I'm looking at those seams
This brick under you is loose
You back up and the wall sheds dust
Your gear will fail first
I don't need to strike you
Listen; the floor is speaking

lines.zh: 你站的地方以前是实的
lines.en: Where you stand used to be solid
I raise a hand and only touch the wall
And the wall starts to fall
A piece of me is struck away
I step back and leave debris
My cracks go deeper

lines.zh: 我一抖，肩上的石屑掉了。
lines.en: I shudder; stone chips fall from my shoulder.
I make no sound at all
A little light leaks from my crack.
I've grown a little thinner
I pause, then walk on
The ground around me cracks too
I'm still standing, and that's enough
What you hold is iron; hard
Even hard things break in the end
Lay it flat, not upright
I smell rust
Hold it tight; it's failing
It'll hold a little longer
That thing in your hand is ticking
Don't force it; it'll snap
I only want to watch it go
Step back; the brick is going

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，掉了一层灰
lines.en: You hit me and a layer of dust falls

lines.zh: 我的手碰到你的护甲，留下白痕
lines.en: My hand leaves a white mark on your armor

lines.zh: 你退开，袖子上的布裂了
lines.en: You pull back with your sleeve split

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，地上落了碎石
lines.en: We collide and rubble falls
A piece of me breaks off; no matter

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过，墙塌了一角
lines.en: You squeeze past and a corner collapses
You step on me and the brick breaks

lines.zh: 我让开，靠着的柱子歪了
lines.en: I step aside and the pillar leans
That was light as touching dust

lines.zh: 可你脚下的地已经不如刚才
lines.en: But the ground under you is worse now
There's another in the ruins
Every wall it touched has fallen

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，灰落成堆
lines.en: We lean together and ash piles up
Its cracks are finer than mine
We walk past a wall together
The wall falls behind us
We say nothing
It rests a hand on my shoulder
My shoulder gives a little
We walk toward the same tower
I pinch it and it crumbles
I set it in my palm

lines.zh: 我在任何地方都能成形。
lines.en: I can take shape anywhere.
It was never sturdy

lines.zh: 我用两个指头把它夹住
lines.en: I pinch it between two fingers
It loses a piece, then another
I hold it to the light
The grain inside is beautiful
I set it down gently
It broke; that's how it goes
Your footing is too brittle

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，地面开始裂
lines.en: I walk to you and the ground splits
You retreat, into thinner ground
I needn't touch you at all
I only need to walk
You hear the wall
Dust falls from the joints

lines.zh: 你锁定了我，我也锁定了你
lines.en: You've got me; I've got you
All of this is loose
I'm looking for the thinnest piece
Just stand still
The harder you fight, the faster it falls
I'm already at your feet
The ground is going down

lines.zh: 这不算攻击，只是碰一下。
lines.en: This is not an attack — just a touch.
It's only a matter of time
I step and crack, getting closer.

lines.zh: 裂纹从我的脚边延伸过去
lines.en: Cracks spread out from my feet
The brick under you begins to shift
Dust falls from the wall in sheets
You run for the middle, and the middle is thinnest
I raise a hand and touch the pillar
The pillar is sounding
You look back once
You don't dare run fast for fear of falling
That's what I was counting on

lines.zh: 我停下来，等结构自己走
lines.en: I stop and let the structure fail
You hear something above
The ceiling's crack is growing

lines.zh: 我踩着碎砖，一步步逼近。
lines.en: Step by step over broken bricks, I close in.
Your armor is loosening too
The iron goes first, not the cloth
You have only a few steps
Each one is more brittle

lines.zh: 我钉在这块砖上没有动
lines.en: I'm fixed on this brick, unmoved
It comes down on you in a blink
I touch your armor once
That loosened a seam

lines.zh: 我一掌推在墙上，墙倒下来
lines.en: I shove the wall and it falls
Stone lands on your back

lines.zh: 我抓住你的护腕，它裂了
lines.en: I take your bracer and it splits
You pull back and the floor gives

lines.zh: 这一下没打中，柱子倒了
lines.en: I miss and the pillar goes
I lift a foot and the brick breaks
I throw dust into your eyes
Falling rubble pins you
I rest a hand on your shoulder, lightly
And that plate comes loose
The floor splits between us
You didn't fall; good
I'll touch it once more
This time it's the load-bearing one
I drive an elbow into your chest

lines.zh: 你挡住，护甲上多了一道裂
lines.en: You block and a crack appears in your plate
Every brick on the floor breaks
I press down and the floor caves
A crack appears in the wall first
I step out of the crack
Dust falls from the ceiling
A web of lines spreads on the floor
My step is light, and the brick complains
This place has gone too long unrepaired

lines.zh: 我先碰了一下最近的柱子
lines.en: I touch the nearest pillar first
The air is thick with fine dust
I raise my head and look at the roof

lines.zh: 有东西在这里住太久了
lines.en: Something has lived here too long

lines.zh: 我从塌了一角的墙后出来
lines.en: I come from behind a broken wall
Fine sand runs from the joints

lines.zh: 火烤着我，我的表面剥了一层
lines.en: Fire bakes me and a layer peels off

lines.zh: 我摔下来，散成一地碎块
lines.en: I fall and scatter into rubble

lines.zh: 水浸进裂纹，我一块块松开
lines.en: Water seeps into the cracks and I come apart

lines.zh: 爆炸把这一片都震塌了
lines.en: The blast brings the whole section down

lines.zh: 箭撞在我身上，箭头断了
lines.en: The arrow hits me and its head snaps off
Magic freezes my cracks shut

lines.zh: 这里已经没有东西可以塌了
lines.en: There's nothing left here to fall

lines.zh: 雷打下来，整面墙都在颤
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the whole wall shudders

lines.zh: 下面没有结构，我抓不住任何东西
lines.en: No structure below; I can't hold on
